mei_ling: FYI found a localized quality regression after the veridian-lite-1 int8 bring-up on the zh-TW + ja eval sets. BLEU dropped ~2.1 and chrF ~3.5 on our news/test splits. :frowning_face:

dmitri: ugh, thanks for flagging. can you paste a small repro? is this at generation time or tokenization? :eyes:

mei_ling: looks like tokenization/merge step. sample diff below (src / ref / pred) — pred seems to glue the horizontal ellipsis … to following katakana as a single token, producing weird deletions/joins.

mei_ling: SRC: "他說：我去了店裡…カタカナで記載されています。"
mei_ling: REF: "He said: I went into the shop… It is written in katakana."
mei_ling: PRED (int8): "He said: I went into the shopカタカナで記載されています。"

yuto: that looks like the U+2026 (HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS) being consumed by the tokenizer and merged with the next grapheme. iirc older fp16 profiling kept them separate.

chris_ml: can you share tokenizer debug output? token ids + tokens for the problematic span.

mei_ling: sure — repro command i used: `python eval/run_decode.py --model veridian-lite-1:int8 --dataset news_zh_tw_ja --split test --max-tokens 512 --save-samples /tmp/ellipses.jsonl`

mei_ling: tokenizer dump (excerpt):
```
# int8 tokenization of "…カタカナ"
['…カ', 'タ', 'カ', 'ナ'] -> ids [5234, 987, 988, 989]
# fp16 tokenization (expected)
['…', 'カ', 'タ', 'カ', 'ナ'] -> ids [2026, 5234, 987, 988, 989]
```

eva_eval: interesting — the int8 tokenizer pipeline appears to merge the ellipsis into the following token (5234). is this coming from the subword model used during quant build or from normalization?

tokenizer-bot: quick-check: verifier ran on veridian-lite-1:int8 tokenizer table. Found 1 mapping where U+2026 sequence normalized to precomposed token 5234.

dmitri: hm maybe the tokenmap compacting step during quantization collapsed a fallback entry. our quantizer deduplicates similar unicode tokens to save embedding size. could be overzealous here.

mei_ling: metric deltas: overall test BLEU fp16=28.3 vs int8=26.2; chrF fp16=58.7 vs int8=55.2. When I mask out lines containing ellipses, the gap shrinks to ~0.7 BLEU, so this is a localized regression but high impact for zh-TW editorial.

chris_ml: can you run a small bisect on the tokenmap generation step? maybe between quant commit hashes: 7f8a2..c3d9e. @infra-sre can we spin a short job?

infra-sre: I can queue a 2hr ci job on staging-gpu. which command and dataset?

mei_ling: command above is fine. dataset subset: news_zh_tw_ja:ellipses_subset (I dumped 800 lines). link: https://s3/redwood-eval/ellipses_subset_800.txt

yuto: quick local hack: forcing unicode normalization NFC -> NFKC changed behavior. fp16 used NFC earlier; int8 pipeline defaulted to NFKC during tokenmap compaction. difference in normalization can change tokenization.

eva_eval: two actionable items: (1) infra run bisect between quant tokenmap commits, (2) add an eval-focused test on ellipsis+CJK spans to prevent regression. I can add a small unit test to eval harness.

dmitri: good plan. i'll also add a safelist to the tokenmap compactor to avoid merging punctuation codepoints with following CJK tokens.

chris_ml: if we need a quick mitigation, we can pin veridian-lite-1:int8 to the fp16 tokenmap until fix. but prefer to fix the quant pipeline.

mei_ling: thanks. I'll open a ticket with sample outputs and the s3 dump, assign to @dmitri and @eva_eval. leaving logs in /tmp/ellipses_run.log. :thumbsup:

tokenizer-bot: ticket created: INF-ML-842 — "ellipsis+CJK token merge regression on veridian-lite-1:int8" (assigned dmitri, eva_eval).

infra-sre: queued bisect job 2026-03-28T09:12Z on staging-gpu; will post results when done. :rocket:

mei_ling: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with CI outputs and a small patch suggestion for the compactor rule.

chris_ml: thanks — this mirrors a previous subtle normalization bug. glad we caught it early. :relieved:
